items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: I used to cut Aaron's hair in school... I'd always get him and I'd cut his hair and he'd just be tickling, laughing

ctx.x: : Well, there's one thing. Where did Aaron Bell's mother come in the picture?
Aaron Bell's mother. That's what I was intending to get to when we first started talking. And that was -- now, you know, when I used to go to church?
